::: {#exr-cutoff-parts}

#### The parts of the 0-or-1 rule

The course overview's [rule for 0 or 1](course-overview.qmd#exr-zero-one-cutoff)
calls an image a 1 when its center ink is above a cutoff,
and found its cutoff by trying every value from 0 to 16 in steps of 0.5.
Name:

- its [model family](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-model-family),
- its [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
- its [loss function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-loss-function),
- and how it was fit.

:::
